game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before skeleton miners overload Echo Chamber.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Archive variation 4: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for General-purpose languages.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: loop_safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
